name: Text to Sound Studio
summary: Prompt-first sound generation: select model and settings and start a new run directly from the View, with live progress.
help: Prompt, model and settings, a Generate sounds button that starts a run with those settings, and the live progress of the generator (connect its telemetry to Live generation progress). The generated takes are shown in a separate player panel.

inputs.label: Live generation progress
inputs.help: Connect the generator telemetry to display stages and progress while it works.
